mmlupro-baseline.description: Thinking off. Verified 2026-09-22 against llama-server --help on both boards: -rea is --reasoning, the thinking switch, NOT --reasoning-format. --reasoning-budget -1 is already llama.cpp's default; it is passed explicitly so the resolved command line records it.

mmlupro-thinking-on.description: The reasoning row. --reasoning-format MUST be pinned to none: left at its 'auto' default the thoughts go to message.reasoning_content, which lm-eval never reads, and answers arrive truncated or empty.

lg-baseline.description: S3, little-gemma thinking off: the -rea off counterpart. No <|think|> in the system turn (shim --thinking off) and engine -think -1, the --reasoning-budget -1 counterpart, passed explicitly so it is on the command line. -raw must be on, or the engine wraps the prompt in a second user turn. Context 8192 and the 2048 answer cap are compiled in; engine_build.txt in the run directory records the build.

lg-thinking-on.description: S3, little-gemma thinking on: the -rea on --reasoning-budget 320 counterpart. <|think|> in the system turn (shim --thinking on, byte-identical to llama-server's -rea on render) and engine -think 320, which force-closes the thought channel at 320 tokens. Thoughts come back inline, as --reasoning-format none returns them.
